data.animaCaption: Standing before the closed dark wooden door in her red-and-gold brocade qipao and twin floral hair buns with one hand poised lightly at her hip, she glances back over her shoulder with cool grace and a faint blush. Warm hallway sconce light glides across the silk brocade.
data.promptProse: Composed in a subtly tilted vertical full-body shot before a closed dark timber apartment door, Shiki Natsume wears her canonical crimson-and-gold floral brocade qipao with fitted long sleeves, high side slit, black thighhighs, and twin hair buns pinned with red blossoms. Resting one hand lightly at her hip, she turns back over her shoulder toward the viewer with poised elegance and a quiet touch of shyness as warm hallway wall light catches the golden floral sheen.
data.story: 推门前最后一步，换上红金织锦旗袍的夏目扶着木门轻轻回眸。双丸子头上的红花衬着黑发与金瞳，她克制地收起笑意——「看够了就快走吧，预约的时间要到了。」
